Method of Attack: Injected malicious code to download and execute files (~x and ~u) from ptpb.pw
Modified systemd to add a timer to run the malware periodically
Collected system data including date/time, machine ID, CPU info, Pacman details, uname -a and systemctl list-units outputs
Exfiltrated collected data to Pastebin using attacker's custom API key
Impacted Systems: Arch Linux systems using AUR packages
Attack Vector: Compromise of orphaned user-submitted packages on AUR repository
